name: Bug report
about: Report a problem with the install / update / uninstall scripts
title: "[Bug] "
labels: bug
---

**Describe the bug**
A clear description of what went wrong.

**To reproduce**
The exact command you ran (install / update / uninstall) and any output.

**Expected behavior**
What you expected to happen.

**Environment**
- OS: [e.g. macOS 15.6 / Ubuntu 24.04 / Windows 11 + Git Bash]
- Trae variant: [CN / international]
- bash version: [`bash --version`]

**Additional context**
Anything else that might help.
